why: this batch's r/MMA free-posting item mixes fakes staged as true with ordinary in-joke memes, so telling T3-001's April Fools fakes from T3-031's running jokes is the hardest line here.

why.T3-004: the concepts settle the mark's look — three-pixel letters, two-pixel whitespace and the red dot on the i — and correct coordinates so the design is drawable, which is working out the mark's design, not proposing it (T3-033) or circulating a finished template (T3-070).

why.T3-023: the moderators replace the whole subreddit's CSS, cursor, banner and vote icons with an Edmond display and members play inside it — a staged sub-wide April Fools takeover.
why.T3-097: many concepts give ways to get past the prank look — uncheck use subreddit style, install RES, recover the cursor — treating the styling as something to work around.
why.T3-032: several concepts condemn the jokes themselves as unfunny, played-out memes or torture and ask for the layout back.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: the single T3-023 placement would leave unplaced the many concepts that treat the prank styling as something to escape rather than play inside.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: c0001 and c0049 give explicit instructions for turning the subreddit style off, satisfying T3-097's gate with their own distinct concept.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-097 — dropping it loses the readers who get past the look rather than play in it or object to it.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: the single T3-023 placement would leave unplaced the concepts that object to the jokes themselves as unfunny or torturing and ask for them to come down.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: c0059 calls the styling torture rather than a trick and c0123 faults the played-out memes, satisfying T3-032's gate with their own distinct concept.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-032 — dropping it loses the objection to the jokes as jokes, which T3-023's gate does not reach.

why.T3-171: the concepts direct the Grey Blob's grey itself — seizing white space, building a dark grey pillar, taking the checkerboard overnight, expanding fast and replacing only black — a colour spread as the faction's aim, not a picture grown over a neighbour (T3-061).

why.T3-001: members post their own fakes as true for April Fools — a USADA violation, a confirmed McGregor-Mayweather fight, a Hamill result — and others expose and reveal them.
why.T3-032: concepts fault the fakes as not clever or believable and call a ban for the fake injury report, objecting to the jokes themselves.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: the single T3-001 placement would leave unplaced the concepts that object to the fakes as irresponsible or unfunny and ask for them to stop.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: c0181 calls for a ban over the fake injury report and c0143 faults the fake as not clever or believable, satisfying T3-032's gate with distinct concepts beyond the staging.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-032 — dropping it loses the policing side of the item's own label.

why.T3-136: the concept doubts UCF redditors would show up on the canvas at all, a doubt about the room having the people for a work rather than a question about how the room shows or a judgement on the canvas.

why.T3-038: the item builds and reports the mark — making the spot red first, laying out the exact blocks, finishing the A, claiming the spot and holding — while the template-sharing, calling, explaining, designing, diplomacy and defence concepts are named under also_present.

why.T3-031: the thread is the room's own running humour — a collective self-caricature, neckbeard and fitness jokes, parody credentials — the room's in-jokes rather than the sub's ordinary subject or an April Fools fake.

why.T3-097: the moderators end the shitpost day — shitposts off the menu, the old skin back — and members turn the Edmond styling off, the prank styling got past; the continued fakes, objections and in-jokes are named under also_present.

why.T3-136: the concept doubts UCF redditors would show up because they care more for their fandoms, a doubt about the room's people for a work rather than a question about how the room shows or a judgement on the canvas.
